question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{5,9,12,13,14,15\},$ and the set $S=\{5,9,12,13,14,15\}$ has $|S|=6$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{6}, & x=5,9,12,13,14,15 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $2$ items $(5,9)$ that satisfy $X<12.$ Therefore,

$$
P(X<12)=2\cdot \frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{3}.
$$
